meta.notes: Self-expanding query pool used by the weekly audit routine. Seeds are hand-curated from Meridian's services + suburbs. The routine re-checks each query against live search results every Saturday, harvests up to 5 new queries per run from Google autocomplete on the seeds that matter, and demotes queries that stop yielding useful signal. See docs/audit-dashboard-setup.md §6 for full routine prompt and self-expansion rules. 2026-07-17: autocomplete fetch (suggestqueries.google.com) STILL blocked by routine host egress allowlist — confirmed again via curl ('CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'). Workaround retained: pool self-expands via queries derived from previous-run SERP gaps + new site content (source: 'derived'). Durable fix = widen the routine egress allowlist.
